messages:
Ethan: Paging alerts didn't go to on-call this morning, seems like pagerbot ack state got stuck. noticed customer-facing 503s and no pages. pinging ops.
Maya: omg, saw a flurry of 503s in datadog around 08:12, but my phone was quiet. did pagerduty get anything?
Liam: PD shows incidents created but no notification attempts after the first. looks like our webhook retries never fired.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3212, severity: high, affected: /api/generate (region: us-west). Assigned to oncall rotation: infra-oncall.
Sasha: Are pages suppressed by the bot due to handoff? I was switching on-call at ~08:10.
Jules: I did a manual handoff at 08:09 via /oncall handoff maya -> sasha. can confirm oncall-rotation-bot acknowledged.
Ethan: here's the pagerbot log snippet around the window:
```
2026-03-15T08:10:05Z [pagerbot] received webhook for INC-2026-3212
2026-03-15T08:10:06Z [pagerbot] creating PD incident
2026-03-15T08:10:06Z [pagerbot] received ack_state: PENDING
2026-03-15T08:10:07Z [pagerbot] ack_state transitioned -> PENDING (no change)
2026-03-15T08:11:00Z [pagerbot] notification scheduler skipped: handoff_lock=true
2026-03-15T08:12:00Z [pagerbot] notification scheduler skipped: handoff_lock=true
```
Maya: handoff_lock=true — that's the clue. did we leave the rotation in a transient state?
Liam: oncall-rotation-bot shows the rotation in 'pending_handoff' for 30s then accepted. but pagerbot's scheduler reads a cached flag from redis key `pager:handoff_lock` which wasn't cleared.
Sasha: I ran `redis-cli GET pager:handoff_lock` just now, it returned "1".
Jules: That key is supposed to expire after 10s. looks like the TTL wasn't set on creation in the new handoff flow.
Ethan: I can reproduce locally: creating the key without EXPIRE because of a race in the RPC wrapper. patch idea: setnx + expire in the same Lua script so it's atomic.
incident-bot: Automation note: historical incidents with handoff_lock stuck: 3 in last 90 days.
Maya: Customer impact note: we had retries client-side but the error rate spiked to 12% for 6 minutes. A handful of active customers reported failed requests.
Liam: mitigation: I manually DELETED the redis key at 08:15 and triggered a replay of pending notifications. PD then attempted notifications and pages went out.
Sasha: thanks. PD shows multiple notification attempts starting 08:15:05. we also sent SMS followups to top-tier customers.
Jules: action items we agreed on voice: 1) hotfix: atomic setnx+expire lua for pager:handoff_lock (Ethan), 2) add an alert when the TTL on handoff key > 30s (Liam), 3) post-incident customer assessment draft for SRE (Maya).
Ethan: hotfix drafted, will push a canary to staging then prod. patch in branch: fix/pagerbot-handoff-lock.
Liam: I'll add a grafana panel for handoff_lock TTL and a cron job to scrub stale locks every 5m as a short-term guardrail.
Maya: Customer comms: will draft an email and a status page update noting delayed paging and 6m error spike. will include mitigations and apology.
Sasha: any regrets about the handoff UX? maybe the rotation bot should confirm completion only after pagerbot acknowledges.
Jules: good point — currently handoff flow is multi-step: rotation-bot triggers pagerbot to re-bind, but there's no confirmation handshake. add that as a medium-term infra ticket.
incident-bot: Postmortem checklist: attach logs, timeline, root cause, mitigation, customer impact, rollout plan for hotfix, and retrospective notes.
Ethan: timeline summary for postmortem:
- 08:09:12 user-initiated handoff: maya -> sasha (rotation-bot)
- 08:10:05 pagerbot received webhook; created PD incident
- 08:10:06 pagerbot set handoff_lock without TTL due to race
- 08:11:00 notifications skipped (scheduler sees handoff_lock)
- 08:12:00 errors spike to 12%
- 08:15:03 Liam deletes redis key manually
- 08:15:05 pagerbot retries notifications, pages delivered
- 08:18:00 error rates back to baseline
Maya: Good. I'll own the customer impact section. Ethan, assign the PR to me for review.
Ethan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pagerbot/pull/458 (hotfix). tagging @Maya @Liam for review.
Liam: I'll add the alert: alert if `redis_ttl(pager:handoff_lock) > 30` for 2 minutes.
Sasha: Follow-up: add unit tests for the lua script and an e2e test for handoff flow. I'll file tickets.
Jules: Can we also gate handoffs during scheduled deploys? we had a deploy at 08:05 which may have tightened the race surface.
Ethan: noted. final note: temporary mitigation applied (scrub job + alert). hotfix will be shipped in next patch release.
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll draft the postmortem and status page, will ping for review. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: This thread marked for postmortem: INC-2026-3212.
Sasha: closing loop — if anyone sees residual paging anomalies, ping #eng-oncall.
Ethan: closing thread, will update when PR merges and when the postmortem is published.
